verdict.rationale: Bulk or batch operations are a fair axis for an AI inference and fine-tuning platform, but the evidence shows no documented way to act on many existing items at once, such as batch inference or batch job or model management. POST /generations with a count of 100 to 10,000 examples generates one synthetic dataset rather than operating across many items. Training every smaller size up to max_depth is a single training job's behavior. Neither is a bulk-operations capability, so both are adjacent at most.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
